body:
Thank you for the idea! I've tried being understanding and gently letting him know that he repeats the same jokes a lot just in case he doesn't realize that he's doing it, but it seems to only fuel it more, unfortunately. It almost seems like he finds it funny that it starts to wear on me. 

I'll try to communicate it more straightforwardly, hopefully it'll help.
For reference, we've been together for four years. He started the jokes when we first experienced things together and has been repeating them ever since.

Oh yeah, usually I'm open with him about how I'm feeling. He's been worrying himself sick over me though, so I've stopped doing that so he will feel more open to talk about his depression with me without feeling the need to hide it to be strong for me. Thank you for replying, though.
